meta_title: Mersey Rd Gardening | Landscape Gardener Liverpool
meta_description: Mersey Rd Gardening transforms Liverpool gardens with expert landscape design, planting, and maintenance. Local family business. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Local Landscape Experts — Aigburth & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Whether you need a full redesign or regular maintenance, we'll create an outdoor space you'll love to spend time in.
services_heading: Complete Garden & Landscape Services in Liverpool
services_subhead: From design and build to seasonal maintenance and specialist planting, we handle every aspect of your outdoor space.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke landscape designs tailored to your space and vision. We assess soil, sunlight, and existing features to create a garden that works with your home, not against it.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Expert installation of patios, decking, raised beds, and pathways using quality materials. Built to last, with proper drainage and finishing that complements your home.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection for colour, texture, and year-round interest. We establish healthy borders, plant trees and shrubs, and create wildlife-friendly spaces.

services.title: Garden Maintenance Plans
services.desc: Regular upkeep tailored to your needs — hedge trimming, lawn care, weeding, and seasonal work. One visit a month or weekly, whatever suits your garden.

services.title: Lawn Care & Grass Services
services.desc: Lawn treatment, aeration, feeding, and overseeding to restore tired grass. We tackle moss, bare patches, and worn areas so your garden looks lush and healthy.

services.title: Fencing & Boundary Work
services.desc: Supply and installation of fencing, trellis, and boundary features. We use durable materials and ensure everything is level, secure, and finished to a high standard.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We just help you write the best one.
about_para_1: Mersey Rd Gardening was founded on a simple belief: your garden should be as beautiful and functional as the rest of your home. Over 15 years, we've helped hundreds of Liverpool households create outdoor spaces they genuinely enjoy — from small courtyards to sprawling borders. We work with the seasons, the soil beneath your feet, and the unique character of each garden.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on listening first and designing second. We don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. Whether you want a low-maintenance modern space or a traditional cottage garden bursting with colour, we'll get it right. Customers come back to us year after year because we care about the long-term health of your garden, not just the quick fix.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolute game-changer. We had a tired, overgrown mess at the back. They cleared everything, laid a new patio, and planted some brilliant shrubs and perennials. The whole team was tidy and professional. Really pleased with how it turned out.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Been using Mersey Rd for maintenance for two years now. They come every month, keep the borders tidy, and always spot things before they become a problem. Fair pricing and never try to upsell you on work you don't need. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Emma H.

reviews.text: Had my whole garden redesigned during lockdown. They listened to what we wanted, came back with sketches and plant lists, and the finished job exceeded expectations. Looks like it was designed by a magazine. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: James P.
